# AETHER ADB workstream — dependency requirements (scratch file for the integrator)
# Format: implementation("group:artifact:version") // reason
# Do NOT edit gradle/libs.versions.toml or app/build.gradle.kts here; the integrator wires these.

# No third-party ADB dependency.
# Rationale: tananaev/adb-lib (com.tananaev:adblib:1.3 on Maven Central) implements only
# classic plaintext ADB (CNXN/AUTH/shell) and predates Android 11+ wireless debugging
# (TLS + SPAKE2 pairing). It has no TLS layer and a blocking-socket API unfit for
# coroutines. The pairing handshake (SPAKE2 + AES-128-GCM peer info) and the TLS-tunnelled
# ADB transport are hand-rolled in app/src/main/java/id/mybase/aether/adb/ and verified
# byte-for-byte against BoringSSL's SPAKE2 oracle vectors. See docs/adb-pairing-protocol.md.
